rule: An older Polar subscription event (active) must not overwrite a newer one (canceled)
invariant: SELECT status <> 'active' FROM subscription WHERE id='sub_1'
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: INSERT INTO subscription(id,status,"modifiedAt") VALUES ('sub_1','active','2026-02-01 10:00:00+00') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status,"modifiedAt"=excluded."modifiedAt" WHERE subscription."modifiedAt" IS NULL OR subscription."modifiedAt" <= excluded."modifiedAt"

INSERT INTO subscription(id,status,"modifiedAt") VALUES ('sub_1','canceled','2026-02-02 10:00:00+00') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status,"modifiedAt"=excluded."modifiedAt" WHERE subscription."modifiedAt" IS NULL OR subscription."modifiedAt" <= excluded."modifiedAt"
